newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian November inflation slows to 9.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian November inflation slows to 9.7 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly consumer price inflation slowed to 9.7 percent in November from 16.7 percent in October, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES NOV OCT NOV'95
BREAKDOWN (cumulative inflation since Jan 1 in brackets)

"Inflation slowed down because food prices which have the largest weight in the basket rose modestly last month compared to other groups of goods and services," a NSI official who declined to be named told Reuters.

The lev fall against the dollar on the domestic forex market had only a limited impact on inflation because the slide accelerated in the second half of November, boosting the prices of non foods and services, the official said.
The lev fell to 365 to the dollar on November 29 from 245 at the beginning of the month.
